reason: Owner-approved release of #1237: Admin Users adds a Signed out vs signed in section returned with the existing GET /v1/admin/users response (optional activity_from/activity_to params, play_activity field). It reports players, completed runs, first-Daily people and next-day return over a Pacific date range using the Daily habit cohort definitions and exclusions. Read-only query; a failure logs admin_play_activity_failed and the account list still loads. No schema migration, gateway route or admin API version change. Use the existing protected development-to-production release and exact-revision acceptance checks. Preserve production data, identity, gateway quota state, credentials, secrets and monitoring. Do not publish native builds, change store tracks or send social posts.
